question: At what rate of simple interest will ₹2,000 become ₹2,520 in 4 years?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Simple Interest (SI) generated in 4 years = 2520 − 2000 = ₹520.

Interest per year = 520 ÷ 4 = ₹130.

Rate % = (Interest per year ÷ Principal) × 100

Rate % = (130 ÷ 2000) × 100 = 6.5%.

**∴ The correct answer is 6.5%.**
